_comment: Events that distort what the site measures: diversions, closures, strikes. Kept permanently, unlike data/disruptions.json, whose notices are pruned once they end. Nothing here removes data by itself: the builders mark each journey and delay-map cell an entry touches (`exclusions`, `excluded_by`), and `--exclude` drops them when that is decided. Read by scripts/analysis_exclusions.py; see docs/RUNBOOK.md, 'Adding a disruption'.

exclusions.summary: Western Road, Hove, closed between Holland Road and Montpelier Road; Brighton & Hove routes diverted via Montpelier Road, Davigdor Road, Holland Road, Montpelier Place and Lansdowne Road.
exclusions.note: Buses on these routes skip Norfolk Square, Brunswick Place and Montpelier Road (Waitrose) and take longer between Palmeira Square and Waitrose; lateness picked up there carries on down the route. Journey times and delay-map cells through the area during the dates are not typical of the route.
